pages.text: Strike amethyst and its echoes answer one another. This tuner remembers the rhythm of an aether flow and passes that rhythm to another device.

pages.title: Remember upstream, then downstream
pages.text: For pulses, select the emitter and then its destination.$(br2)For resonance, select a connected resonator and then a downstream resonator or workshop device. Each resonator follows one parent but can feed several branches.$(br2)Use the tuner in the air to clear a mistaken selection.

pages.title: Rearrange the flow
pages.text: Sneak-use a child resonator to detach its parent. It can become a new root beside a reservoir. Sneak-use a root to change its frequency, then retune the downstream branches.$(br2)Sneak-use a world anchor to select one or nine chunks, or other devices to pause output. A resonance tree cannot loop back into itself.
